anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: you shall eat it in haste; it is a Passover to the Lord.

pass_a_gloss: For if those too were making this haste, the bringing him upon the sacred-service for their sanctification, which for them the command fulfilled: You shall eat it with haste; it is a pascha to the Lord, which is a going-over of the Lord.
pass_b_english: For if those too were making this haste, to bring him to the sacred service for their sanctification — which for them the commandment fulfilled: "You shall eat it in haste; it is a Passover to the Lord," (Exodus 12:11) which is a going-over of the Lord.
source_text: Εἰ γὰρ κἀκεῖνοι σπουδὴν ἐποιοῦντο ταύτην τὸ ὑπὲρ ἁγιασμοῦ αὐτῶν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ἱερουργίαν ἄγειν, ἣν αὐτοῖς ἡ ἐντολὴ πεπληρωμένη τό· "Φάγεσθε αὐτὸ μετὰ σπουδῆς, πάσχα ἐστὶν κ(υρί)ῳ", ὅ ἐστιν ὑπέρβασις κ(υρί)ου.
